  SELECT unit_code, attempt_no, verdict,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_code, attempt_no ORDER BY posted_min DESC, log_id DESC) AS revision_rank
  FROM inspection_log
  WHERE posted_min <= 480
), attempts AS (
  SELECT unit_code, verdict,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_code ORDER BY attempt_no) AS attempt_rank
  FROM revisions
  WHERE revision_rank = 1 AND verdict IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT e.press_code, COUNT(*) AS inspected_units,
       SUM(a.verdict = 'pass') AS first_pass_units,
       (10000 * SUM(a.verdict = 'pass')) / COUNT(*) AS yield_bp
FROM press_entry AS e
JOIN attempts AS a ON a.unit_code = e.unit_code AND a.attempt_rank = 1
WHERE e.entry_min >= 0 AND e.entry_min < 480
GROUP BY e.press_code
ORDER BY e.press_code ASC",
  "decision-preview-deck-session-scheduling": "WITH offers AS (
  SELECT offer_code, start_min, end_min, seat_count * (end_min - start_min) AS minutes
  FROM preview_offer
), candidates AS (
  SELECT d.order_id, a.offer_code AS first_offer, NULL AS second_offer, a.minutes AS seat_minutes, 1 AS sessions
  FROM deck_order AS d CROSS JOIN offers AS a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.order_id, a.offer_code, b.offer_code, a.minutes + b.minutes, 2
  FROM deck_order AS d CROSS JOIN offers AS a
  JOIN offers AS b ON b.start_min >= a.end_min + d.reset_min
)
SELECT order_id, first_offer, second_offer, seat_minutes
FROM candidates
ORDER BY seat_minutes DESC, sessions ASC, first_offer COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_offer COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-price-prepaid-cancellation-credits-from-term-notices": "SELECT t.term_id,
       (t.paid_cents * (t.end_day - t.cancel_day) * (100 - n.deduct_pct)) / (100 * (t.end_day - t.first_day)) AS credit_cents,
       n.source_id
FROM prepaid_terms AS t
JOIN term_notices AS n ON n.tier_code = t.tier_code
 AND n.issue_day = (SELECT MAX(m.issue_day) FROM term_notices AS m WHERE m.tier_code = t.tier_code AND m.issue_day <= t.first_day)
WHERE t.first_day <= t.cancel_day AND t.cancel_day < t.end_day
ORDER BY t.term_id COLLATE BINARY ASC",
  "decision-print-only-changed-shelf-labels": "SELECT 'code,caption,price_cents' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(record, ''), '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(d.code, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(COALESCE(d.caption, ''), '"', '""') || '",' || CAST(d.price_cents AS TEXT) || char(10) AS record
  FROM desired_label AS d
  LEFT JOIN printed_label AS p ON p.code = d.code
  WHERE p.code IS NULL OR COALESCE(d.caption, '') <> COALESCE(p.caption, '') OR d.price_cents <> p.price_cents

WITH revisions AS (
  SELECT unit_code, attempt_no, verdict,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_code, attempt_no ORDER BY posted_min DESC, log_id DESC) AS revision_rank
  FROM inspection_log
  WHERE posted_min <= 480
), attempts AS (
  SELECT unit_code, verdict,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY unit_code ORDER BY attempt_no) AS attempt_rank
  FROM revisions
  WHERE revision_rank = 1 AND verdict IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT e.press_code, COUNT(*) AS inspected_units,
       SUM(a.verdict = 'pass') AS first_pass_units,
       (10000 * SUM(a.verdict = 'pass')) / COUNT(*) AS yield_bp
FROM press_entry AS e
JOIN attempts AS a ON a.unit_code = e.unit_code AND a.attempt_rank = 1
WHERE e.entry_min >= 0 AND e.entry_min < 480
GROUP BY e.press_code
ORDER BY e.press_code ASC

WITH offers AS (
  SELECT offer_code, start_min, end_min, seat_count * (end_min - start_min) AS minutes
  FROM preview_offer
), candidates AS (
  SELECT d.order_id, a.offer_code AS first_offer, NULL AS second_offer, a.minutes AS seat_minutes, 1 AS sessions
  FROM deck_order AS d CROSS JOIN offers AS a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.order_id, a.offer_code, b.offer_code, a.minutes + b.minutes, 2
  FROM deck_order AS d CROSS JOIN offers AS a
  JOIN offers AS b ON b.start_min >= a.end_min + d.reset_min
)
SELECT order_id, first_offer, second_offer, seat_minutes
FROM candidates
ORDER BY seat_minutes DESC, sessions ASC, first_offer COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_offer COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1
